Ace Disarm.descriptionOnly: no path: the –2 it no longer takes is Ranged Disarm's, on the maneuver it makes

Ace Trip.descriptionOnly: no path: the –2 it no longer takes is Ranged Trip's, on the maneuver it makes; the DC is the target's

Advanced Weapon Training.descriptionOnly: no path: the advanced weapon training option it picks is written as a feature of its own

Burrowing Shot.descriptionOnly: no path: the –2 on ability checks, attack rolls, saves and skill checks is the struck creature's

Compulsion Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: suggestion from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +9 and +12

Curse Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: bestow curse from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +9 and +12

Cut from the Air.descriptionOnly: no path: an attack of opportunity at its highest bonus deflects a ranged attack, at the table

Devastating Assault.descriptionOnly: no path: one attack rolled as a full attack, at the table

Dispel Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: dispel magic from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +9 and +12

Dwarven Fury.descriptionOnly: its rules change no number the sheet keeps

Dwarven Hatred Style.descriptionOnly: no path: its hatred bonus +2 on attack and damage

Dwarven Seething.descriptionOnly: no path: its defensive training or hatred against the opponent that hit it, whatever its type, at the table

Elven Battle Focus.descriptionOnly: no path: its Intelligence modifier in place of another ability's on the weapon's damage, while in Elven Battle Style, which no path replaces

Empty Quiver Style.descriptionOnly: no path: melee attacks with its ranged weapon as a mace, at the table

Energy Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: burning hands from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +6, +8, +10 and +12; two uses for lightning bolt

Finesse Shot.descriptionOnly: no path: shooting objects, their AC

Flight Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: fly from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +9 and +12; armor's enhancement bonus in place of Dex on Fly while it lasts

Illusion Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: minor image from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +6, +8, +10 and +12

Illusive Gnome Style.descriptionOnly: no path: the bonus on a feint is 1 + the level of the spell it sacrifices, at the table

Illusive Gnome Surprise.descriptionOnly: the pick of a weapon special feature after a feint is made at the table, for its Charisma modifier (minimum 1) in rounds

Marksman's Utility.descriptionOnly: no path: the +4 is on the attack roll a utility shot makes

choices.label: Martial Focus: the fighter weapon group (heavy blades, bows, ...)

Martial Focus.descriptionOnly: only with a weapon it is proficient with

Outslug Weave.descriptionOnly: no path: Outslug Style's +1 made +2; its damage on the style's chosen weapon is added at the table

choices.label: Overwatch Style: the bow, crossbow or firearm

Overwatch Vortex.descriptionOnly: no path: the –2 is on the readied attacks its action makes

Retributive Kick.descriptionOnly: no path: an unarmed attack at the same attack bonus after a missed first attack, at the table

Smashing Dent.descriptionOnly: no path: the 1 less armor bonus and 1 more armor check penalty are the sundered armor's

Smashing Style.descriptionOnly: no path: the pick is one axe, hammer or flail; a sunder against armor lets it bull rush or trip, at the table

Spellcut.descriptionOnly: no path: its BAB in place of a save, once a round, at the table

Startoss Comet.descriptionOnly: no path: a second thrown attack at its full bonus after a hit, at the table

Startoss Shower.descriptionOnly: no path: its numbers are the attacks its action makes (1 + 1 per 5 points of BAB)

Startoss Style.descriptionOnly: no path: its +2 more a feat that lists this style (+6 at most)

Swordplay Deflection.descriptionOnly: after a successful parry, until the start of its next turn

Swordplay Style.descriptionOnly: only with the chosen blade; no Combat Expertise penalty on its first attack, at the table

Targeted Blow.descriptionOnly: no path: twice a day, once more a day at BAB +10, +15 and +20, which charges can't follow

Telekinetic Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: telekinesis from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +9 and +11

Teleportation Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: dimension door from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +9 and +12

Vision Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: darkvision or see invisibility from an item once a day, once more a day at base Fortitude save +6, +8, +10 and +12

Weapon Material Mastery.descriptionOnly: no path: the +4 on Knowledge checks is the onlookers'; its other numbers are DCs and dispel checks, by the weapon's material

Weapon Style Mastery.descriptionOnly: the second style beside its chosen weapon style; it doesn't stack with others that allow more styles
